patch_description: The recommendation states that the 2-state [level, slope] model with Q = 0.05·(median|diff|)² outperformed the 3-state constant-acceleration model: 3-state curvature injects jitter (Gens 25/26/28/32), while the 2-state RTS variant achieved lower lag error and better noise reduction with equal correlation. The current best program (0.63) already keeps RTS + local hysteresis and dropped the lead stage; the remaining proven win is switching to the simpler, better-tuned 2-state model. This reduces spurious curvature wobble (lower slope_changes/false_reversals, higher smoothness) while RTS recovers responsiveness.
